title: Elham Teams With Daiwa-Backed Bank to Tap Japan Private Credit
content: Elham Credit Partners, the private credit arm of Hillhouse Investment, has partnered with a Daiwa Securities Group-backed digital investment bank to explore private credit opportunities in Asia Pacific, with an initial focus on Japan, according to a statement.

title: 100% Private Credit ETF Would Be Challenging: BlackRock

title: Senators Scramble for Health Subsidy Solution as Time Runs Out
content: A bipartisan group of senators is making a long-shot bid to break a stalemate over health care subsidies, while also acknowledging that time has run out to pass legislation before the credits expire Dec. 31.

title: Markets Await Payrolls, Retail Sales, and CPI | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 12/15/2025
content: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec discuss the release of economic data expected this week and what lies ahead for the Fed in 2026. Bloomberg's Michael McKee and BNP Paribas Head of US Credit Strategy Meghan Robson join the show to break it down. Also on today's show, Chris Palmeri on the Netflix co-CEOs attempting to reassure staff about the company's Warner Brothers deal, and Bloomberg's Michelle Davis on dealmakers delivering their second-best year ever with the WBD Blockbuster capping an impressive M&A finish to 2025. Plus, National Grid New York President Sally Librera examines energy grid demands as data center power costs weigh on many Americans' bills. title: Lenders Demand $100 Million Payout After CommScope’s Asset Sale

title: BlackRock’s Koesterich Sees 2026 as a Year of Differentiation

title: Seed Funding In 2025 Broke Records Around Big Rounds And AI, With US Far In The Lead
content: The seed investment environment exhibited its typical quirkiness in 2025. In particular, it was a huge year for huge rounds. Predictably, it was also a banner period for AI dealmaking with the U.S. pulling in a bigger-than-usual share of total investment.

title: PayPal applies to form bank that can offer small business loans and savings accounts

title: Esusu, platform for renters to build credit scores, valued at $1.2 billion in new funding round

title: Refinance demand for FHA loans jumps 24%, as homeowners seek the most savings they can

title: What another Fed cut could mean for your personal borrowing costs

title: 42% of student loan borrowers say bills make it harder to cover basic needs such as food, survey finds
content: A large share of student loan borrowers report that their debt makes it harder to cover basic needs such as food and housing, a new report finds.
